title: Emptiness Immersion
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 43.4 Linked Discourses 43.4
  • 1. Paṭhamavagga Chapter One

Suññatasamādhisutta Emptiness Immersion

“Katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo? “And what is the path that leads to the unconditioned? Suññato samādhi, animitto samādhi, appaṇihito samādhi—ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo …pe…. Emptiness immersion; signless immersion; undirected immersion. …”

Catutthaṁ.
